comment: E2 / ADR-055: curated Live TV, about 20 working channels per country, picked from the iptv-org database (public domain, https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv) and probed on every sync. Countries use iptv-org codes (UK, not GB). Published to the streams branch under curated/ only when the repository variable YUMEIRO_CURATED_LIVE is true.
